## P0 — Correct trust and obvious defects FIRST
### A. PokeMMO-aware in-game Pokédex, not generic National 649 default
- In the third user video (00:28–00:56), actual PokeMMO National Pokédex displays **Seen 436/604, Owned 216/603, Caught OT 187/603, Caught Alpha 14/362, Owned Shiny 7/603, Owned Costumes 1/12**, with numbers, silhouettes, registration borders and advanced filters. This is per-character snapshot evidence. **Do not hardcode the user counters**, and **do not present 649 as in-game available**. Preserve an optional clearly separate "All Gen I–V reference" view (649 IDs) only if users choose it.
- Build a **versioned PokeMMO species inclusion/availability registry** with provenance/patch applicability and discrete states: `in_game_dex`, `wild_permanently`, `event_or_time_limited`, `roaming`, `story_temporary`, `contested_temporary`, `unavailable`, `unknown`. "Obtainable", "Can encounter", "Appears in in-game dex", "Eligible caught OT" and "User owns" are DIFFERENT axes. Do not derive blindly from `obtainable: true` or location row count.
- Specific regression list: **Virizion #640, Tornadus #641, Thundurus #642, Landorus #645, Keldeo #647**, plus **Cobalion #638, Terrakion #639, Kyurem #646, Meloetta #648, Genesect #649, Reshiram #643, Zekrom #644**; evaluate each using current PokeMMO rules. Do not categorize them all identically or simply remove IDs without review.
- PokeMMO dex should expose real 2026 dimensions: National/region dex (not confused with Generation introduced), type/egg groups/abilities, stats, wild held items, tier search when verified; registration statuses: Unregistered / Seen / Owned / Caught OT / Caught Alpha / Shiny / Costumes. Default cards should resemble the **functional model** of the in-game icon grid (not copied atlas), not all "already caught". Unseen entries can be silhouette/unknown; where personal status unavailable, mark **not tracked by Companion** rather than silently unseen. Per-character manual progress allowed, *never* claim account sync.
- Follow PokeMMO details page taxonomy: Summary, Moves, Base Stats, Wild Locations, Evolution Tree, Type Matchups. Add optional Companion-only Breeding and Notes in a separate secondary area. Mark source provenance/age without badge spam. Correct 'Lure', 'Special', '???', horde 3/5, seasonal rows, missing move metadata, temporary events.
- Current 604/603 counters from video are source-specific, not universal. Validate membership against latest official patch + current screenshots, ideally build an offline manifest difference report listing currently included IDs vs in-game version. Show source patch/checked date in app. Existing 107 headless tests are NOT proof of PokeMMO correctness.

### B. Fix the exact popout cap
`ui/js/popouts.js` `pokedex()` ends filtered list with `.slice(0, mode === 'expanded' ? 200 : 60)`. **Remove arbitrary limits**. Properly render/virtualize/page the complete eligible PokeMMO roster with search/filter and all selected entries accessible. Count should match result set. Test #001 through last included entry by scrolling on Compact, Standard and Expanded; no blank section after 60, 200 or filter change.

### C. Don't force raw dump import each install
- Owner explicitly wants PokeMMO data present in the usable app. Prepare PokeMMO-derived **factual metadata** from permitted sources with provenance, respecting redistribution conditions. Ship a functioning species/availability/move/stats reference where rights permit.
- For sprites and any client-owned proprietary dump content, do **NOT** put original dump/client assets in public GitHub just to satisfy convenience. Implement a **safe one-time guided local auto-detect and opt-in install**: read-only search only known user-authorized locations / selected folder (their PokeMMO Flatpak install location and local `Pokemmo-Dumps` folder may be candidates), digest/version-check, import to Companion-private user directory, cache for future launches. If legal access/format cannot be validated, explain specific missing source; don't claim packaged game sprites are present.
- Progress and user settings survive replacing/reimporting source data. No auto-upload.

## P1 — UX changes that the video makes obvious
### D. Popout size presets + manual resizing
- Switch to meaningful, tool-specific starting window geometry: Compact = smaller, Standard = medium, Expanded = larger; these are **preset sizes**, not locks. Example Pokédex proposed 320×440 / 460×600 / 700×720 logical px, adaptable to DPI/screen. Each mode changes visible content hierarchy and sprite-card density. Pick reasonable values individually for Guide, reports, Type Chart, breeding and other popouts.
- Switching mode should resize once to preset **unless user opted for preserving custom size**. After switching, the user can resize freely; remember custom geometry per tool/mode, restore on next launch, clamp to visible monitor. Do not snap back repeatedly during manual resize. Opacity/pin/position-lock remain independent.
- Compact Pokédex uses a genuinely denser grid (small cards, more per row when sufficient width), Standard balanced, Expanded spacious/readable or richer details. Independent grid density control preferable for power users. No arbitrarily truncated content.
- KDE Wayland through XWayland functionality already visually demonstrable; keep fallback for native Wayland and don't force cross-platform claims without tests.

### E. Accurate two-axis type chart
- Matrix has **ATTACKER ROW (Y)**, **DEFENDER COLUMN (X)**. Hover/keyboard focus must light *entire corresponding row AND column*, including headers; intersection gets strongest readable highlight; show persistent detail label like `Flying attack → Grass defender: 2×`. Clicking locks focus; Esc/unpin clears. Include scroll/sticky headers and accessible labels.
- Maintain a separate defensive check with up to two defending types, AND add explicit offensive check as useful, not misleadingly combine direction.
- Golden examples: Flying→Grass x2, Ice→Flying x2, Electric→Ground x0, Normal→Ghost x0, Grass→Water x2; account for Gen V PokeMMO's 17 types and known type specifics. **Do not invent Fairy type.**
- Chart and popout need readable cell sizes and legend; on narrow Compact show deliberate focused row/column rather than squeezing 17×17 unreadably.

### F. Homepage redesign preserving proven data
- Preserve **Official Events and Changelog detail views** (user likes them). Improve Home to feel like a main landing page: memorable but restrained header/featured official update, next verified official events, compact Alpha/Swarm/cave/legendary source status, prominent **Continue current named run** and configurable pinned tools, recent/favourites. No crowded KPI dashboard, no giant unused black space or default purple. Responsive at 800px, 1100px and 1440+ app widths.
- Status/date/source labels must remain correct; historical ended content does not turn current because of styling.
- **Automatic official news/event refresh**, not only manual `Check forum`: permitted feed/request adapter, reasonable timer/caching & rate limits, conditional checks when available, edited-post handling. Keep clear 'last checked' and per-entry source. When source blocks details, display new official title/link with **'Summary pending verification'**; never pretend a title-only feed supplied article content. Keep old verified snapshot while offline, not fake current.

### G. Sidebar pinned Quick Access
- Keep permanent five main categories Home/Pokédex/Tools/Live/Guides and Settings gear.
- Under them add an optional **Quick Access** group (separate from primary page routing): drag e.g. Type Chart, Breeding Planner, Damage/Catch Estimator, Natures, favourite Guide or Pokémon, Team Builder into sidebar. Also a keyboard-accessible `Pin to sidebar` action for users who can't drag.
- Reorder via drag, unpin/context menu, persistent independent list (limit with overflow on short windows). Normal click opens tool main page; adjacent/alternate action opens separate popout, no accidental duplicate app. In horizontal nav provide a corresponding compact quick-tools strip/overflow, not an extra sixth tab.
- Do not display disabled tools as active; show disabled reason if numerical accuracy unverified.

### H. Detail pages, overall visual quality, consistency
- Rework Pokémon Summary from plain stacked text into strong first-screen information hierarchy: sharp sprite, name/number/type, gender/forms/shiny when supported, clear selected tab, six visually balanced stats, abilities, sourced catch info and meaningful next actions. Avoid 10 badges in the header; don't invent account-owned state.
- Improve sidebar typography, default main app content area usage, Settings controls and density, Tool hub size, easy in-page back navigation, popout type chart readability. Consistent native Qt titlebars/toasts (`qt_shell.py`) **and web CSS** (`tokens.css`, `app.css`).
- Extract actual Better Default 1.8.0 theme token values from a readable local user's theme file if accessible; do NOT claim screenshot-sampled hex values are exact. Maintain per-component contrast/readability.
- Toast corner setting is ALREADY available: keep all four choices and make **top-right** the default for *new profiles*, without overwriting existing user-chosen settings. Existing reports and notification privacy/dedup behavior preserved.
